Welcome

Your notes → study guide, quiz, or adaptive session

AI Study Buddy works entirely from materials you upload and doesn't browse the internet. Upload your lecture slides or textbook notes and get a personalized study guide, quiz, or adaptive session that targets your weak spots.

Step 1: Add your material

Upload files or paste notes, then index

1Upload (1.1): drag in a PDF, PPTX, JPG, or PNG. Or paste text (1.2) directly from your textbook. You can do both at once.
2Index Materials: hit the button to process everything. The counters below update to confirm what was indexed.
Step 2: Option A

Get a Study Guide from your material

Click Study guide in the left sidebar. On the Study Guide page, choose Deep Mode (thorough) or Cram Mode (quick hits), then hit Generate Study Guide. The guide is built section by section from exactly what you indexed.

Step 2: Option B

Test yourself with an Interactive Quiz

Click Quiz in the sidebar. Pick how many questions you want (5, 10, 15, or 20), then hit Generate Quiz. Questions come directly from your indexed notes, so every answer is in your material.

Step 2: Option C

Let Adaptive Study find your weak spots

Click Adaptive Study and hit Start Diagnostic Quiz. It runs a quick assessment across all your topics, then automatically generates a focused study guide or quiz on the areas you struggled with most.
